wy-ems-rules-ch13.note: Authority W.S. 35-2-1001 (enacted by S.F. 147, 2013; S.F. 88, 2015 added Acute Stroke Ready Centers). Categories include Comprehensive Stroke Center, Primary Stroke Center and Acute Stroke Ready Center, plus heart attack receiving and referring centers. Designation "shall be contingent on the accreditation of the facility by an accrediting agency" (the American Heart Association, the Society of Cardiovascular Patient Care or The Joint Commission), and the Office of EMS answers an application within 30 days with a letter of recognition or a request for more documentation. Wording seen only through web-search extracts of this mirror (sections 13-2, 13-4, 13-5) in October 2026; the official text on rules.wyo.gov was not opened. Cited as the basis for inferring that a Wyoming hospital with no national stroke accreditation found has no state designation found; not a campus observation.
